title: Restore the Ops SonarCloud CI analysis configuration
goal: Make the hosted SonarCloud Scan workflow analyse pantheon-ops again by restoring the Ops-owned sonar-project.properties that the v0.17.7 consumption silently dropped, and declare it in business-overlay.json so a future consumption cannot drop it again.
dependsOn: maintainer-supplied SONAR_TOKEN for this repository (the previous value returned HTTP 403 from api.sonarcloud.io)
blocks: green SonarCloud Scan on pantheon-ops main

in: Restore sonar-project.properties with the content it held at 5c12964f^, including sonar.projectKey, sonar.organization, source exclusions, coverage exclusions and cpd exclusions.
Record the overlay contract, rebuild reproducibility and hosted SonarCloud Scan results.
out: Any change to .github/workflows/sonarcloud.yml semantics, job conditions or gate policy.
Any change to SonarCloud project settings, quality gates or organization membership.
Introducing a second Sonar analysis channel or uploading coverage from a local run.
Re-committing or re-asserting the token value inside the repository.

doNotTouch: .sonarcloud.properties (scopes SonarCloud automatic analysis and is already declared)
any repository secret value inside the working tree

implementationNotes: copyDeclaredPath copies every declared repositoryOverlayPaths entry from the Ops tree regardless of whether Base ships that path, and the product-root guard only rejects backend, frontend/src, frontend/tests/smoke, database and schema, so a root configuration file is a legal repository overlay.

The file disappeared at 5c12964f (consume pantheon-base-v0.17.7) because it was never declared; the rebuild had no instruction to keep an Ops-only root file. This is the same failure class as the pinned task-manifest overlay found in the 0.18.1 round: overlay declarations, not file content, decide survival.

.sonarcloud.properties and sonar-project.properties are both required and are not duplicates: the scanner CLI that the workflow runs only reads sonar-project.properties, while .sonarcloud.properties scopes SonarCloud's automatic analysis.

The restored file also carries sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/* and sonar.cpd.exclusions; without them the built-in Sonar way new_coverage condition on the Free plan cannot be neutralised, which is why the file existed in the first place.
SONAR_TOKEN was rotated by the maintainer for this repository; with it installed the scan authenticates and now fails only on the missing mandatory properties, which is what this packet closes.

consumerSpecificControls: repository overlay declaration is the survival mechanism for Ops-only root configuration
staging rebuild used to prove the file survives a consumption round
deferredCodeIssues: Dependabot-triggered runs cannot read repository secrets, so SonarCloud Scan stays red on Dependabot PRs until Dependabot secrets are provisioned or the job is made to skip that actor; that is a gate-policy decision for the maintainer.
The SonarCloud quality gate for duanxldragon_pantheon-ops is currently ERROR on new_security_rating; clearing those findings is product work outside this packet.

designGate: inheritance boundary note: base ships no sonar-project.properties, so the file is Ops-owned configuration and must be declared as a repository overlay
developmentGate: file restored from its last known-good revision rather than rewritten
overlay declaration added in the same change so the repair is durable
qaAcceptanceGate: check:business-overlay and test:business-overlay after the declaration
rebuild:from-base showing the rebuilt tree still contains sonar-project.properties

affectedSubgraph: business-overlay.json repositoryOverlayPaths -> rebuild-from-base assembly -> Ops-only root configuration -> .github/workflows/sonarcloud.yml -> sonar-scanner CLI
riskNodes: CI-based analysis authentication and project identity

successful analysis and quality-gate read-back from the SonarCloud web API after the change
hosted SonarCloud Scan run conclusion on main
